avis.texte: Differin Acne Cleanser is one of the best facial treatments that I've used. I've had acne since I was about 13, and I'm 18 now. Throughout those five years, I have used alcohol-based cleansing pads, Proactive, and just regular hand soap products, none of which achieve the success of Differin. I have been using Differin Acne Cleansing for about a year now, and although it took my skin a couple of days to make the switch from different products, this treatment has decreased the number of breakouts I used to have, the redness in my face, and has just overall improved my skin. Differin Acne Cleanser is a Benzoyl Peroxide-based acne treatment, which is known to be one of the better products to use when treating acne, blemishes, and breakouts. When buying an acne treatment people tend to pay attention to the cost, smell, and effect. Differin is fairly cheap for what it can do. I buy my product from Walmart, and it costs me about $11.00, but each bottle can last up to a month. It also has no smell and is very effective for people with oily skin because it has a Benzoyl Peroxide-base, in which it dries out the excessive oil that causes breakouts and blemishes. This product has two counterparts: the Differin Moisturizer and the Differin Gel. The moisturizer is to help moisturize your skin, that way your oil glands don't over excrete to do the same task. This product costs about the same as the cleanser, and it lasts a long time, as I use it twice a day and it has lasted me about four

This product has been a lifesaver. I was dealing with relentless hormonal adult acne. My skin had zero issues until a few months ago. I was shocked when I started getting jaw breakouts. With the stress of wedding planning, travel, and diet changes—my skin looked almost as bad as it did as a teen. Break out after break out for months. I stopped all the acid based products I was using and gave up on Tretinoin. All I use is this wash, a gentle cleanser and lotion. My skin is doing so much better. This WORKS!

I’ve been using the Differin Acne Face Wash with 5% Benzoyl Peroxide every day, and I’m really happy with the results. It leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed without feeling overly dry. After a couple of weeks, I noticed fewer breakouts and my skin looked clearer and smoother. The cleanser has a creamy texture, rinses off easily, and works well as part of my daily skincare routine. If you’re looking for an effective acne cleanser that helps keep blemishes under control, I definitely recommend giving this one a try!

I really like this stuff. Second time buying it and it’s worth the price. I have suffered from acne in my 20s and has been the one thing that has helped control my acne even after being on Accutane. It does dry the skin and can irritate it if you use it too much so start slow but I recommend it to everyone

avis.titre: The only product I use for my acne outbreaks
avis.texte: I work outside a lot, so I am constantly getting dirty and sweaty. I am also pretty prone to acne popping up at the worst time. I can use this product and within 24 hours my outbreaks are mostly cleared up. My face feels smoother and less gritty from clogged pores, and my skin doesn't feel dried out either. My teenage son also uses this product and says it helps his acne as well. This 4 oz size bottle usually lasts the two of us several weeks. A little goes a long ways. Great product, highly recommend.

We combine this cleanser with other Differin products and think very highly of them. They work amazingly for my two teenage boys, both of who send 3-4 hours a day in the summer wearing helmets, as well as one who wrestles. My older son was having trouble with breakouts, and started using this as part of his program and it cleared his face up quickly. This is a great step above basic cleanser before going to a dermatologist or getting on medication. You do want to keep in mind that the first couple weeks, skin will be a bit more dry and more sensitive to the sun, so finding the right balance between using lotion without clogging pores and remembering sunscreen is important!
Doesn’t really see result, it will be better it if have more foam but at least doesn’t make me breakout. No smell so it a pro. Won’t make my skins feel tight.
We have this product on a subscription for AutoShip. Easy to use Great for my own daughter‘s skin. Great for sensitivity.
This facial cleanser is really good. It leaves my skin soft and I can see the difference

avis.titre: Works great! Noticed a difference in days!
avis.texte: This acne face wash has worked really well for my skin. It leaves my face feeling clean and refreshed without being overly drying, which is something I’ve struggled with in other products. After using it consistently, I’ve noticed fewer breakouts and my skin looks much clearer overall. It has a nice, gentle feel but still does a great job of deeply cleansing my pores. I’m really happy with the results and would definitely recommend it to anyone dealing with acne-prone skin.

This products has worked wonders for me! Since about 2 years ago I WAS struggling with severe cystic acne. My face was always red and in pain. About a couple of months with horrible cystic acne I discovered DIFFERIN. I tried so many other brands and they seemed to make my skin worse even if I followed their instruction and bought all their products for acne. When I started using Differin I finally found THE product. I started with the adapalene gel and noticed a difference, after a few weeks I seen my skin getting worse. I was so disappointed but I read the FAQ and saw that it said it might worsen before it gets better. I continued using it. I seen they had a cleanser, the daily deep cleanser. So I started using it with the gel and it was amazing. After a YEAR of cystic acne I seen a CHANGE. I am so happy with my facial skin now. At the moment I began to get cystic acne in my chin again but I stopped using the products for a while because I felt better from my face. Learned my lesson, I will continue to use. I feel confident to say that these products work miracles. If you are suffering from cystic acne get the daily deep cleanse and the adapalene gel and use them, if you see it worsen go though it and continue. Don’t stop. You WILL be happy with your results. To add to this I do have bad scarring in my face from all the cystic acne and I seen they have a resurfacing cream so I am going to try that out. I hope I will see wonders like I did with these products. Thank you for r

avis.titre: Takes time and trial/error but it works!
avis.texte: I used accutane when I was younger to get rid of my acne and I hated it. So when my acne got bad again, I was determined to find the right answer without a dermatologist. For 9 months, I tried many different things that didn’t work and I was ready to give up when I decided to use this product along with its adapalene retinoid gel. It didn’t clear everything up in the time frame advertised, but I saw small improvements, so I stuck with it. Over time, I found a combo of products that work for me: hydrating facial cleanser and oil-controlling moisturizer in the morning (and after sweating) and this cleanser and adapalene gel in the evening. It’s been months and, other than a little bit of scarring and redness, my acne is clear. No more painful cysts. I’m going to stick with it to see if the redness will go away, but I’m quite satisfied.

I have been using this for 5 years now . I had bad acne . Was ashamed to wear my bare face always wore foundation to cover it up but after this my skin cleared up . I swear by it !!! I use this everyday when I shower . I don’t use anything else

I have really sensitive skin and I cant use any of the other sensitive products. This however, caused no irritation and I saw results the following day. The product is soft and feels good to the skin. Washes off easily and the lather isn’t thick. Easy to use. Has been added to my regular products.

So I got acne from changing my birth control. It caused a break out of cystic acne on my chin. I tried natural remedies like honey, ice, aloe and other things that normally work but none of them did, so I'm trying this. I've been using it for 5 days and its been okay. I used it all over my face and I was hoping it would give me a "glow up" improve my skin overall but no, it burns. Im going to use it where I need it which is just on my chin. The rest of my face is fine so I'm just going to focus it on my chin. Update: I stopped using moisturizer and the product is working way better for me. Since I first posted I got 3 new pimples so I stop using the moisturizer. I use it as a spot treatment so its not too drying. Tips: Don't use all over face unless you need to Only leave it on 20 seconds or less Use Ice on burns

avis.titre: Worked well for me but beware if you have sensitive skin
avis.texte: Recently my acne has beem horrible after wearing a mask every day. I was using things like clean and clear and still having horrible breakouts. So I just randomly looked up acne products and decided to try this face wash out. The pictures are just under a month apart and I think you can see the difference! Not 100% cured, but its the best results I've had with a product so far. Beware though, this face wash will definitely stain your towels so be careful! Also, the first few times using this I did have some redness and it felt slightly itchy afterwards. After using the product for almost a month now there is no redness or itching anymore.

avis.titre: Box and bottle arrived damaged, but the product itself works.
avis.texte: I only gave this three stars because the product itself works. HOWEVER the box arrived damaged, and the cap arrived loose, almost falling off the bottle. When I went to open the flip lid, the entire cap popped off and cleanser exploded everywhere. WHY did Differin switch to these horrible caps?? I definitely will not be buying these through Amazon again, that’s for sure!

avis.titre: This product does exactly what it says!
avis.texte: Not for everday use but works well when I use it a few times per week. You only need a small amount with each use so it’s great value for the price.

this product has helped me tremendously however it’s sooo drying and for somebody that has severely dry and sensitive skin, it can be very stripping. Besides that this product has helped my skin a lot as you can see from the review pictures.

avis.titre: Clears your skin but bleaches your towels!
avis.texte: I only get a minor break out every now and then but since i started using this cleanser i've had almost completely clear skin. A little drying but not too bad. One big thing to note- it will leave bleach spots on your towels!!

I am very disappointed ordered and was excited to try it but arrived open and used! I ordered again another one hoped to receive new one but another one cane open and used too . I have to throw them in the garbage. Very disappointed!

After using this product a few times I noticed my towel had bleach stains. To make sure it was from the face wash, I dabbed a dot on the towel and the next morning that part of the towel was bleached. I don’t feel comfortable putting a product on my skin that bleaches. Something to consider when deciding to try!

My face began to break out in these red painful pimples that looked horrible. Many will say to trust the process, but I don’t have the patience. Especially because my face was doing well before. It was just super oily. Would not recommend.

My box was not damaged how did I receive this product already opened?! I just requested a refund and I will be returning the product tomorrow!

Just a note to beware if you order this item as I did and you end up with a broken box and a tube that had cream on the top like it was used. You CANNOT return this item. So basically I just flushed my money down the proverbial toilet.
I have sensitive skin and it broke me out wayyyy more than using a regular cleanser. Don’t waste your money and time
it literally made my skin peel off my face. and it burns. don't buy this

I really think they should stop advertising this as “safe for sensitive skin.” I wanted to try something different to deal with some mild hormonal acne I was experiencing. Used the smallest amount I could because having really sensitive skin makes me weary of introducing new products. I put on moisturizer, went to sleep, woke up and my skin was inflamed, red, and on fire. Couple hours later, hundreds of these pustules formed all over the bottom half of my face. Ultimately, this product completely destroyed my skin barrier and I suffered a severe, very painful case of perioral dermatitis. I had to go to urgent care and get prescribed an oral and topical antibiotic to help get my skin back to normal. Overall, did not have a good experience using this product. I would HIGHLY HIGHLY HIGHLYYYY suggest you (anyone with sensitive skin) do a small patch test before putting this all over your face.

This cleanser is good for me but it’s a little dry on my face. It does bleach out on your clothes . It’s a great prioduct and not very expensive. Just make sure you used more moisturizer when using this.

avis.titre: It has improved my skin after dealing with cystic acne skin
avis.texte: I can’t believe that I have finally found a product that helps my skin not be oily, perfect for my very sensitive skin and I know it’s not an overnight solution so it will take some time for the acne to be removed overtime with daily washes on my face and changing my eating habits as well. I have always had horrible acne skin, embarrassing marks that not even makeup would cover up and it would be acne noticeable. I tried literally most products out there: Olay- left my skin very oily Cetaphil- left my skin feeling unclean Clinique- expensive for me and left my skin horribly dry and more acne Cera ve- basically felt like I was rubbing lotion on my skin I don’t mean to leave a negative review on other products but that’s been my experience and have been felt like I have lost hope and gave this product a sure why not give it a try . In my experience and the pictures I have posted are a big change compared to how I had my skin before not fully clear but getting there. I think this product is good and a great buy

avis.titre: Greatest acne product I have ever used
avis.texte: I’m 30yr and I have had bad, cystic and hormonal acne my whole life, which has not subsided into adulthood. I started using this product about 2 months ago after a particularly bad breakout on my chin. This product has quite literally changed my life. I finally feel like my acne is under control and my skin/acne scars are healing. I still get an occasional pimple but they are smaller and heal much faster. My skin texture has improved and my chin area is nearly flawless. I love that this product is gentler than some other benzoil peroxide products at 5% (versus other products at 10%). I use this product every morning as the first step in my skincare routine. Yes, it does stain clothes and towels, but with care that can be minimized-just have a designated face towel (not your nice towels) to dry. A towel sacrificed to this product is worth it! Highly HIGHLY recommend.

avis.titre: Love the Cleanser Dislike the Bottle
avis.texte: Love the cleanser hate the new bottles. They replaced the bottles and instead of an outie mechanism (labeling male) they have an innie (labeling female). It dispensing from the older bottles (male) it was cleaner with more accuracy and less waste. The newer bottles (female) are less precise with more waste. I'd prefer they go back to the older shaped bottles.

I have been using this product on and off for the past two months. Everytime I use it, the following day my face feels like scales and very dry and sensitive. My skin is naturally dry and oily at the same time. It feels like a thick layer of plaster on my face and only comes off when I scrub it off with a exfoliated brush and different product for like 2 minutes. It makes my skin raw. Afterwards I add the sunscreen daily moisturizer, which is fine by itself, but it burns my face. Like physically burns it. My face becomes red and burns for hours. Anyone know how to fix this?
This product worked but it made me have horrible styes one after another for weeks until I stopped using it.
I guess you can say I have sensitive skin. This broke my face out so bad & made my face very VERY itchy. Don’t believe the hype

avis.titre: NOT FOR SENSITIVE SKIN! Heads up people!
avis.texte: NOT for sensitive skin!!!!!! The adapalene gel does wonders for my acne so I figured the cleanser would go great with my oily skin. Within 2 uses I broke out in a rough, dry, red and itchy rash that burned whenever I put lotion on it and it’s all over my face/neck where I had used the cleanser. I suppose it technically did get rid of my acne but it also dried the living pulp out of my face.... to sum it up- adapalene gel is great for blemishes and acne even if you have sensitive skin, but there’s something in this cleanser that is too harsh to be used all over my sensitive skin each night. Just a heads up to those looking for a solution and not another chore of finding rash remedies!
Was not sealed to show it hasn’t been used before. Was not full either this could be manufactures issue but because it wasn’t sealed it seems suspect.

avis.titre: No seal on face wash! Defective/tampered product.
avis.texte: At first sight the box seemed to have been opened before because of the looseness of the bottom and top openings of the box. When I opened the bottle of Differin face wash there was no seal on the bottle. The Differin gel I purchased from a Walmart had a silver seal on it, so I believe this is a tampered bottle. The face wash is VERY watered down and runny which makes me conclude that water or some other liquid may have been added to the product due to no seal. I tried to go to the refund/return page on Amazon, but apparently this item doesn’t qualify for refunds/returns. Tampered/defective items SHOULD be allowed for refunds/returns. I will NOT purchase from this seller again.

avis.titre: Mom to Mom…buy it and be consistent with daily use
avis.texte: Our acne journey started 5 years ago and we’re still here buying this daily face wash! We’ve survived the dry skin, flaky and hormonal break outs all with staying true to using this daily. It’s all about routine with acne, don’t expect quick results because it does take time. Being consistent with a routine is key. I like that it doesn’t have a smell and is very soft on your skin. It can be used for adults as well if you have stubborn acne, picture me raising my hand in my 40s!!! Mom to Mom, it’s been a WIN in our home! I only give it a four star because I do believe you also need to pair cleanser with a topical gel for best results. Hint: Differin has many options and they also work as well.
Product is fine;however, shipping was terrible and product boxes were damaged.

My daughter use this 2 days in a row and it legit gave her a chemical burn. She was sent home from school because her face was burning so bad. Took over a week for it to clear up. She has very fair skin and this was recommended by her pediatrician. I’m sure it works great for some but definitely not for my daughter.

Smells good cleans good but I started feeling pain in my face and I woke up the next day (about two or three days in) and I'm peeling and have really bad dry skin even after applying moisturizer this morning my eye lids still burn and I'm still peeling.
I really like Differin products normally until I learned it was bleaching my wash clothes. If it’s chemicals are strong enough to bleach towels then they are probably too strong for skin.
